open_explanation_policy: Never auto-certify quality from keywords. Use visible self-review or teacher-review status.
general: Correct science result is necessary but not sufficient for independent mastery.
A successful answer edited later becomes unverified until checked again.
Hints and retries remain available but are recorded in the review summary.
Equivalent valid numeric forms are accepted where specified.

misconception_feedback: Subscripts belong to a substance formula and stay fixed.
Count each element separately; an equal grand total is not enough.
A balanced multiple is valid; simplify only when the prompt asks for the smallest ratio.
